title: When Will AI Hit the Enterprise? Ben Horowitz and Ali Ghodsi Discuss
summary: If you have that thing that has that level of intelligence and can control things and so on, then I do think that's a big risk. While we see consumers jump to try the latest AI apps... We haven't seen anybody with any traction in the enterprise.
